text:
Aisha: Quick sync — we need a final call on the new 'silent-switch' fallback option. goal: let requests fall back without spamming ops during transient noise, but keep enough audit/telemetry to diagnose if it goes sideways.
Connor: +1 to that. main questions: how do we surface degradations later? console? alerts? logs only?
Ruth: I'd prefer minimal alerts by default, but a rate-limited operator notification if the fallback rate > 5% for 10m. ops shouldn't be woken for every tiny blip. :zzz:
Ben: On the API side we can add a flag notify_operator:boolean and audit_sample_rate:float. default notify_operator=false for silent-switch. but product wants easy opt-in.
Shawn: UX ask — in the rollout panel, show a compact badge "Silent fallback active" with a click-to-expand timeline and a sampled list of example requests (PII scrubbed). we also need quick toggle to promote to 'loud' mode.
Aisha: that sounds reasonable. question: do we record every fallback event to bigtable and sample at ingestion, or do we sample at router and tag with reason/error_class? sampling at router is cheaper but loses complete forensic trace.
Connor: sample at router and include sampling_id + quota_used + error_class; store full dump only for sampled ids. that way console playback can rehydrate sampled traces.
Ruth: audit retention — enterprise customers will want full audit on request for 90 days. propose: keep sampled telemetry by default but support backfill export API for customers on Private/Dedicated.
Ben: API contract change proposal (sketch):
```json
{
  "fallback_mode": "silent-switch",
  "notify_operator": false,
  "audit_sample_rate": 0.02,
  "escalation_threshold": {"percent": 5, "window_seconds": 600}
}
```
Ruth: +1 on escalation threshold. also we need a "recently_escalated" flag in the UI to prevent repeated noise.
Shawn: small UX nit — when a user hovers the badge, show: "Silent switch: non-disruptive fallback. Escalate if >5% in 10m" and a link "view sampled traces". keep the panel terse.
Connor: telemetry payload should include: route_id, model_variant_from, model_variant_to, latency_ms_before, latency_ms_after, error_class, sampling_id, operator_notified:boolean. minimal and actionable.
Aisha: ops concern: if notify_operator flips to true during an active incident it could double-alert. we should gate operator notifications through a dedupe layer (same incident id) and rate-limit 1 alert / 5m per team.
Ben: deploy-bot FYI — added a small schema change to router: fallback_reason + sampling_id fields. deploy-bot: config rollout started to canary 10% on prod-router-v3.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: canary roll started (10% traffic) for 'silent-switch' flags. see https://console.redwood.ai/rollouts/4999990000
Ruth: thanks. last question — audit logs: include a compact hash linking sampled event -> full log blob (if present) so we can revoke access if required by compliance.
Aisha: ok let's capture that. action items: Ben to PR API schema, Connor to add sampling_id + minimal payload in router, Shawn to mock the badge/hover in the rollout panel, Ruth to draft escalation policy text for legal/enterprise. I'll reconvene tomorrow EOD. :calendar:
